title: Pretend the box is light
situation: While Dot watches, Bola carries the heavy box upright and smiling. The moment Dot looks away the effort shows: knees, back, face. Dot looks back and Bola snaps upright. Posture and face are an overlay on a walk that never changes.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
